verdict.rationale: Session replay linked from funnels or errors is a fair question for a web analytics product, so the axis applies. Plausible documents funnel drop-off analysis, but nothing in the pack shows session replays or any way to jump from a funnel step or error event to individual users' sessions. Its stated no-personal-data model also suggests per-user recordings are not offered. The funnel feature is adjacent and earns no credit.
